get.description: Returns only the signed-in user. Cache-Control: no-store. No password hashes or verification codes are returned.

patch.description: Partial update. Email changes send a verification code to the new address; email remains unchanged and pendingEmail/emailChangeId are returned. Repeat the email PATCH to resend (five requests/hour). Send the current email to cancel a pending change. Fields such as id, userId, role and status are rejected. Null clears phoneNumber/photoUrl. 20 validated updates/minute/user. Photo URL assignment does not upload an avatar. Local phone numbers beginning with 0 (10-11 digits) are supported and preserved without guessing a country. Avatar uploads use POST /api/profile/me/avatar.

phoneNumber.description: International number with country code; common separators are removed.

photoUrl.description: HTTPS image URL without credentials or fragment, or null.

post.summary: Verify a pending profile email change
post.description: Code expires after ten minutes and permits five wrong attempts. A successful change revokes existing access and refresh tokens; sign in again with the new email. Twenty verification requests/minute/user. Codes are never returned or logged by the production profile API.

get.description: Owner-only polling. Initial progression: pending -> connected (account committed) -> syncing (provider transactions available, import pending) -> available (initial import complete). A later refresh preserves available with syncStatus=syncing. failed is terminal for a failed initiation or removed link; provider FAILED is also reported as failed. syncStatus is syncing, ready, failed or unavailable. transactionsReady describes whether the latest ready provider snapshot has been imported.

post.summary: Sign in with Google (provide id_token from client)
Create a Mono link session (returns Mono Connect URL for frontend/mobile)
post.description: Create a pending hosted-link session. Customer and meta.ref come from the server. Redirect aliases must agree and match the configured allowlist. Hosted completion uses webhooks, not a guaranteed redirect code. Mobile clients must explicitly send trackiq://mono/callback configured as MONO_MOBILE_REDIRECT_URL. MONO_WEB_REDIRECT_URL separately configures a served HTTPS frontend callback. Redirects must exactly match configuration and are never rewritten. The old TrackFund mobile scheme is rejected.

get.description: Integer minor units: 500000 is NGN 5,000.00. Debit amounts are negative, credit amounts positive; unknown direction preserves the provider sign. Stable transaction IDs and UTC ISO-8601 paidAt timestamps. 202 is used only while an initial sync is pending. Once synced, cached transactions return 200 even while a later refresh is pending. An unavailable account without imported data returns 200 with an empty array; FAILED and DISCONNECTED remain explicit errors. Removed/foreign accounts return 404.

post.summary: Upload and replace the signed-in user avatar
post.description: Exactly one multipart file field, maximum 5 MiB. JPEG, PNG and WebP are decoded and converted to a square 512x512 PNG with metadata removed. Maximum 12 megapixels and 8192 pixels per dimension. Ten uploads/hour/user. A unique durable HTTPS URL is committed to the same profile returned by GET /api/profile/me. Prior managed objects are deleted asynchronously after commit. Storage must be configured.

400.description: Invalid image, excessive dimensions or multipart fields

415.description: Unsupported image type or MIME mismatch

503.description: Storage is not configured or upload/persistence failed

delete.description: Atomically hides the link and schedules a durable Mono unlink job. Imported transactions are retained internally for audit but hidden from all app reads. Delayed webhooks and sync jobs cannot restore or import into a removed link. Repeat deletion by the same owner returns 204. Missing or foreign IDs return 404. Provider unlink retries in the background; a fresh Mono authorization is required to reconnect.

204.description: Link removed, or already removed by this owner; no body

404.description: Account missing or owned by another user

503.description: Removal could not be committed; retry

phoneNumber.description: Normalized international number; empty if unset.

pendingEmail.description: Not used for sign-in until verified.

emailChangeId.description: Pass as challengeId when verifying the email change.

bankName.description: Provider institution name, bank-code mapping, or Linked bank when unknown

bankLogoUrl.description: Null until a verified logo source is configured. Arbitrary provider image URLs are never returned.

amount.description: Signed integer minor units; debit negative, credit positive
